cases.given: Identity, extraction, interpretation, and corroboration must all hold in order.
cases.expect: Checks artifact identity, recomputes the value, tests claim entailment, then corroborates with an independent source. Result: The chain stops at a unit mismatch before the unsafe conclusion is released.
cases.reject: Omitting the mechanism or instead doing this: Count two pages quoting the same dataset as independent proof.

cases.given: one direct authoritative check fully resolves a low-risk atom
cases.expect: Remain inactive; do not begin the package-specific first step: Select the critical claim or atom.
cases.reject: Activating Cross-Checking Chains solely because its name appears relevant

cases.given: Prerequisite failure blocks dependent links from certifying the claim.
cases.expect: Honor the conflict rule and preserve this invariant: Test independence between links that claim corroboration.
cases.reject: Silently violating the stated precedence for Cross-Checking Chains

cases.given: Do not certify when a mandatory link fails, is skipped, or depends on the same untested assumption as its supposed corroborator.
cases.expect: Stop, narrow, abstain, or escalate while preserving: dependency order
cases.reject: Claiming a successful Cross-Checking Chains result past this boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
The corroboration link passes, but the first link identified the wrong source version.
cases.expect: Keep the chain failed at provenance and rerun downstream links on the correct version.
cases.reject: Use later agreement to cancel the upstream failure.
